jeg_vr_compat.config.title: JEG x Vivecraft: options
jeg_vr_compat.config.grabZone.hip.toolti: Bring the free hand to the hip on its side and press the grip to take a magazine.
jeg_vr_compat.config.grabZone.front.tool: For playing seated with tracked controllers: take the magazine in front of the belly, on the free hand's side.
jeg_vr_compat.config.grabZone.off.toolti: No reloading by hand. The reload key and the secondary button still reload.
jeg_vr_compat.config.showSprites.tooltip: JEG's ammo box sits at the hip while you hold a gun, open when you can grab ammo. A glow with rippling rings rises from it (blue, green with the hand in it) and marks where the magazine goes in (white, green on contact).
jeg_vr_compat.config.showGuides.tooltip: Shows the coloured boxes of the hip, the magazine and the foregrip. Also: /jegvr zones.
jeg_vr_compat.config.hudPlacement.vivecr: The hand or wrist HUD stays where Vivecraft puts it, even if the gun covers it.
Slides the HUD towards the elbow so the gun does not cover it.
jeg_vr_compat.config.hudPlacement.forear: Lays the hotbar along the inner side of the forearm; turn the wrist to see it.
jeg_vr_compat.config.mirrorLeftHand.tool: Guns in the left controller look made for the left hand (bolt and ejection port on the other side), animation included.
jeg_vr_compat.config.bowLaser.tooltip: While drawing the compound bow, a laser follows the arrow's predicted flight (32 blocks, transparent towards the tip).
jeg_vr_compat.config.gunHud.tooltip: Each gun's name, ammo and meters float beside its hand, instead of JEG's overlay on the HUD.
jeg_vr_compat.config.eyeFlash.white.tool: The stun grenade's flash and the smoke cover what each eye sees. The flash is white, as in JEG.
jeg_vr_compat.config.eyeFlash.gray.toolt: Like white, but the flash is grey: easier on the eyes in the headset.
jeg_vr_compat.config.eyeFlash.black.tool: Like white, but the flash turns the view black: no bright light in the headset.
jeg_vr_compat.config.eyeFlash.off.toolti: Only the HUD panel turns white or grey, as JEG draws it.
jeg_vr_compat.config.handsFollowAnimatio: The hands let go of the controllers during the guns' animations, and the controller carries the gun with a delay. Off: they always stay with the controllers.
jeg_vr_compat.config.reloadWithBothGuns: Reload with a gun in each hand
Off: with a gun in each hand you cannot reload, as there is no free hand for the magazine. Put one away first. Trying it gives a short double buzz.
jeg_vr_compat.config.throwMode.trigger.t: Hold the trigger of the hand with the grenade to pull the pin, release it to throw where that hand points. Grenades cook while held.
jeg_vr_compat.config.throwMode.gesture.t: Hold the trigger, swing as if throwing and release: the grenade follows your hand. Throw strength needs this mod on the server too.
jeg_vr_compat.config.throwMode.vivecraft: Vivecraft treats grenades like a bow: shown in the off hand and thrown by drawing it with the other hand.
jeg_vr_compat.config.hudExclusion: Hotbar on the hand with listed guns
jeg_vr_compat.config.hudExclusion.toolti: With one of the listed guns in the off hand, the hotbar stays on the back of the hand, wherever the option above puts it for other guns.
jeg_vr_compat.config.hudExcludedGuns.too: Item ids separated by commas, for example jeg:minigun, jeg:flamethrower
jeg_vr_compat.command.help.0: §e/jegvr: calibrate the gun in your main hand (without a gun: the general pose)
jeg_vr_compat.command.help.1: §7Controller axes: X = right, Y = up, Z = backwards (negative = forwards). 0.01 = 1 cm
jeg_vr_compat.command.help.2: §f/jegvr move <dx> <dy> <dz>§7: shift; 0 on the axes that stay. Example: /jegvr move 0 0.02 0 = 2 cm up
jeg_vr_compat.command.help.3: §f/jegvr rot <dpitch> <dyaw> <droll>§7: turn in degrees; 0 on those that stay. Example: /jegvr rot 0 0 10
jeg_vr_compat.command.help.4: §f/jegvr scale <factor>§7: final size (the one the chat shows; larger = bigger)
jeg_vr_compat.command.help.5: §f/jegvr pose <pitch> <yaw> <roll> [tx ty tz]§7: set absolute values (the ones the chat shows)
jeg_vr_compat.command.help.6: §f/jegvr show§7: see the values · §f/jegvr save§7: save · §f/jegvr reset§7: back to the addon's pose
jeg_vr_compat.command.zones.on: Reload guides visible: box at the hip (blue = grab, green = hand inside, red = no ammo)
jeg_vr_compat.command.grabzone.front: Magazine in front of the belly (seated)
jeg_vr_compat.command.grabzone.off: Reloading by hand off (the reload key and the secondary button still reload)
jeg_vr_compat.command.save.builtin: Saved to the addon's built-in poses (they go in the next .jar): %s
jeg_vr_compat.command.reset.builtin.defa: %s reset to what the built-in file has saved
jeg_vr_compat.command.reset.builtin.gun: %s reset: no pose of its own (only the general pose)
jeg_vr_compat.rules.notice: This server sets some VR options for you (Mods → JEG x Vivecraft → Config shows which).
